emptySiyuanTitle: No task blocks in your notes yet

manualSortHint: Switch sorting to Manual to drag tasks.
listHint: List shows every task flat, with no parent indentation or folding. Switch to Tree for hierarchy operations.
helpBody: Up/Down move - Enter edit - Space toggle - N new - Delete trash - Ctrl/Cmd+Z undo. In Tree: Left/Right collapse, Tab indent, Shift+Tab outdent
treeHint: Drop on the middle of a row to nest it, drop on the top/bottom edge to reorder siblings.
treeEmptyHint: Use "Add subtask" on any task, or indent a task-list item in your note. Standalone subtasks are kept inside the plugin.
boardDropHint: Drag a card to another column to change its status
settingSpaceHint: The two spaces are fully isolated: the SiYuan space reads and writes task blocks in your notes, the standalone space only uses the plugin's own storage.
settingDefaultDoc: SiYuan space - where new tasks go
settingDefaultDocHint: Leave empty to use today's daily note. The standalone space ignores this: its tasks are never written to a document.
settingRepeatAdvanceHint: When enabled, completing a repeating task rolls its due date forward instead of marking it done.
aboutBody: Two isolated spaces. In the SiYuan space every task is a real task-list block and nesting is your note's nested list. In the standalone space tasks live only inside the plugin - no document, no block, no search entry. Both share the same list, tree and board views.
